periods.time: Mid-assault, on the laboratory's fourth floor

name.zh: 王马、刀华与艾莉丝阻击亚伯拉罕
name.en: Ouma, Touka and Alice Hold the Abrahams

periods.location: Large experimental field on the fourth floor of Eilands' underground lab
periods.summary: Five Abraham clones ambush the rescue team, forcing Ouma, Touka and Alice to remain behind while Ikki and Shizuku continue toward Stella.
periods.cause: Eilands activates the remaining Abraham series units as his strongest delaying force before the final laboratory level.
periods.process: The Abrahams teleport into melee and attack with fire, ice, psychokinesis and precognition. Ikki and Ouma withstand the first assault, but Touka and Alice are injured. Ouma throws Ikki out of the encirclement and orders him to continue because Ikki's observation-based swordsmanship is poorly matched against ego-less invisible psychic attacks. Touka absorbs the facility's electricity and cuts down one Abraham with Raikiri; Alice binds the others' shadows long enough for Ikki and Shizuku to leave. Ouma prepares Dangetsu Tenryuuzume: Shinuchi by gathering external wind, and Touka fights beside him as lightning.
periods.outcome: The rear guard keeps the Abrahams occupied and ultimately survives, though all three are badly injured before reaching the final battlefield later.
casualties: at least one Abraham clone cut down by Touka
periods.significance: Allows Ikki and Shizuku to reach Stella and shows Ouma, Touka and Alice acting as a true combat team against Desperado-class artificial enemies.
